narrative.overview: MiHorario UNMSM is a light, clean, minimalist single-viewport workspace designed for UNMSM students.

rules.name: The Single-Viewport Rule
rules.body: The main workspace container must fit within 100% of the viewport height (h-screen overflow-hidden).

dos: Do keep colors soft, natural, and highly readable.
Do maintain a strict 100vh viewport fit without page scrolling.
donts: Don't use neon, glowing dark backgrounds, or aggressive contrast halos.
Don't allow window scrollbars or floating modals that hide the timetable grid.
